description:
List the roadmap milestones for a property's task board: id, slug, name, description, start_date/end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), color, progress (0-100, from tasks in the DONE column), state (upcoming/active/overdue/done/at_risk) and task/done counts. Use a returned milestone id or slug with update_milestone or assign_task_to_milestone. dependencies is always [] for now.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// list the roadmap milestones for the property.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com"}
```
name: list_milestones
title: Roadmap milestones
